sources.title: www.Distributome.org: Pareto Distribution Calculator
sources.snippet: This is a simple calculator for the Pareto distribution with shape parameter \(k\) and scale parameter \(b\). The calculator gives the value of the cumulative distribution function \(p = F(x)\) for a given value of \(x\), or the value of the quantile function \(x = F^{-1}(p)\) for a given value of \(p\).
